item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 01/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An upper-air disturbance will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea today. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will be generally fine and very hot over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week, but showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea early next week.

Date/Month: 01/09 (Monday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Becoming cloudy with a few showers. More showers with thunderstorms in some areas at first. Very hot with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
